reviews.title: Inaccurate results
reviews.text: The results from day to day vary by a large amount so I think the app is basically a marketing gimmick to get you to constantly add this or that product made by Clorox.

reviews.title: Used to work
reviews.text: The app used to work fine. I always have a hard time telling the difference between orange and pink/reddish for pH. That fixed it! Take picture of the strip, read the results, adjust as needed. Well, not anymore. The app keeps saying the capture didn’t work. I deleted the app

reviews.title: Don’t Update
reviews.text: Cannot log in after latest update. Not even after password reset. No option for offline calculator without account but can’t log into account. Completely useless

reviews.title: Poor advice and pushes product
reviews.text: The app gave poor treatment guidance. It told me to add pH Up, then later showed my pH was too high, while also recommending stabilized chlorine tablets without clearly warning that they raise cyanuric acid. My stabilizer ended up extremely high, yet the app offered little useful guidance beyond pushing more products (such as stabilized tablets, ironically). Do not trust it.

reviews.title: Inaccurate

reviews.title: App issues
reviews.text: App is giving me a hard time nothing is working I keep having to open and close the app no options are popping up at all

reviews.title: Avoid this app
reviews.text: I like the products Clorox makes except one: this app. I followed the apps instructions on how to treat my pool water after testing with test strips. I eagerly did what the app told me to do which was to add an entire bag of Ph Up chemical. Big mistake. Since then I’ve been trying to rid my pool of excessive amounts of soda ash. My pool water is milky white; the pool bottom is coated in white powder and worst of all no one can swim until all the muck is cleared. Weeks have passed now and I have accumulated every pool chemical known to man trying to correct this. Just save your sanity and do it the old fashioned way.

reviews.title: Connection issue
reviews.text: I have had connection issues ever since I loaded the app. I have deleted it, reinstalled it and still no connection. Nothing in the support option works. Could be a good app if everything worked properly.

reviews.title: Not for spas
reviews.text: The app says “pool and spa”. The test strips say “pool and spa” and recommends using the app. When I try to use the app it does not accept the dimensions of my hot tub because it did not amount to 1000 gallons. So, the app is useless. Wish I had known this benefited I bought Clorox products.

reviews.title: App sucks would give zero stars if it were an option.

reviews.text: This app is wack. The scan test strip is inaccurate. Constantly have to adjust it manually. Just use Gemini. It’s AI can keep track of everything for you, give you accurate information and you can have a conversation about your pool.

reviews.title: Kind of broken
reviews.text:
I wanted to do support, but the support link goes to a generic page so –

You need to scan that strip in 15 seconds, but, even if you have logged in, after you take the picture, it wants you to login again and you lose your results.

Hopefully you remember them, otherwise, you use another strip…

reviews.title: Doesn’t scan test strip
reviews.text: While easy to use, scanning the test strip is useless as it doesn’t scan correctly. Each time it gives the same results and is nowhere close to what the strip actually shows

reviews.title: Email required
reviews.text: Uninstalled - scanner is behind a login screen, and pretty much any other app feature. I’m so tired of this email and account setup tax that’s completely unnecessary. This app USE to work as advertised, I should have expected them to render it completely useless unless you give up more of your time, effort, privacy, and unsolicited marketing spam inbox bandwidth.
